name: page-7eea8332
page_data_script:
blog_category = frappe.form_dict.get('category')
blog_name = frappe.form_dict.get('name')

route = f"blog/{blog_category}/{blog_name}"

blogs = frappe.get_all(
    "Blog Post",
    filters={"route": route},
    fields=["name"]
)
blog = None
if blogs:
    blog = frappe.get_doc("Blog Post", blogs[0].name).as_dict()
    blog.image = f"url('{blog.meta_image}')"
    blog.author = f"Author </br> {blog.blogger}"
    blog.category = f"Category </br> {frappe.get_doc('Blog Category', blog.blog_category).title}"
    published_on_formatted = frappe.utils.formatdate(
            blog.published_on,
            "MMMM d, yyyy"
        )
    blog.published_on_formatted = f"Date </br> {published_on_formatted}"

data.blog = blog
data.blog_category = blog_category
data.blog_name = blog_name

data.metatags = {
    'title': blog.meta_title,
    'image': blog.meta_image,
    'description': blog.meta_description
}
